description: Other places for one stop of a FareDice trip on the same days, keeping the rest of the trip: each with how much the trip's flights change and its link, cheapest first. With city, that change made: the new trip, as get_trip returns it. Places already in the trip, and countries it already visits or (with the link's passports) needs a visa for, are left out.

city.description: A place from the list (its name or IATA city code) to put in that stop's place. Leave it out for the list.

link.description: A FareDice trip link, as find_trips returns it (https://faredice.com/trip?l=... or /sea/trip?l=...).

stop.description: Which stop to change: 1 is where the first flight lands, 2 the next, and so on.

name: swap_stop
title: Change one stop of a FareDice trip
